OzyVTT · polish · consistency sweep 4

Fourth sweep

The last pass, on the mockups as the third sweep left them: every page of the 23 approved mockups at laptop and phone size, in Dusk and in Dawn. 127 pages and 4,731 captures, each measured from its computed style, with the same parts as the third sweep plus eyebrows, notices and the icons inside buttons. Each finding shows its parts before and after its fix, drawn from the approved mockups as they were and as they are now. Press a picture or its toggle to flip it; the after state has an amber frame. On a phone a wide picture keeps its size and scrolls sideways. Under the findings, an amber frame and number mark a capture that differs from its pattern or its rule.

12345678910111213141516SwitchesGM ONLYOverlaysDanger

What doesn't match

Sixteen differences, most to least visible. Four were the third sweep's own leftovers (1, 3, 8, 9) and one a missed date (14). The owner asked for all sixteen, and they are fixed in the approved mockups and their specs (SPEC.md section 7, ADR-0075).

Every picture
1

Level up's step marks are 46 px boxes

D, characters (Level up)

One Steps rail everywhere (rule 4), and the third sweep gave Level up Prep's marks. Its rule .d-dlg .dsteps span also reaches the mark inside each step, so the mark takes a step's 44 px height and 12 px padding: a 46 px square, where Prep, the builder and the Compendium draw a 22 px one.

Fix: Scope the rule to the steps (.dsteps > span), so the mark is the 20 px box its own rule sets.

The captures beside their pattern

2

The Compendium's chips and its open records button are boxed

G, the Compendium (Browsing, laptop and phone)

Chips you choose from, toggles and Filters sit on a Base line (T 2.5). The results toolbar draws its filter chips (CR 0 to 5, TYPE Fey) as 30 px boxes, and the button that brings open records back ("3 records open" on a laptop, "3 open" and "Filters · 2" on a phone) as a box that turns cyan with a glow ring. Kind: Monsters, By name and Clear all beside them are on Base lines, as every other area's toolbar is.

Fix: Filter chips on a Base line with their ×; the open records button and Filters as Base line buttons with their counts, a 2 px cyan base while on. 36 px on a laptop, 44 px on a phone.

The captures beside their pattern

3

Settings' "Today, 8:41 PM" breaks over two lines

I, settings (Access, the credentials table), in Dusk and Dawn

The third sweep wrote a time as "Today, 8:41 PM" (rule 20). In the credentials table's Last used column it wraps, PM on a line of its own, so the Stream overlay row stands taller than the rows under it.

Fix: A date stays on one line (white-space: nowrap), and Last used takes the width of its longest date; the scopes column gives way.

The captures beside their pattern

4

Two phone records keep the section's header and strip

F3, the Atlas (Editing a pin); F, story and people (A faction's standing)

On a phone a record's header is Back and where it goes, with no strip, and its title opens the content (rule 12, the second sweep's 5.2). Editing a pin shows ‹ ATLAS, then the Codex's strip, then a second ‹ Back with EDIT PIN · THORNWICK. The Ashen Hand's page shows CODEX and the strip over the faction's title and tabs. A Codex page shows ‹ PEOPLE and no strip; writing a page and the Compendium's editor show Editing.

Fix: Editing a pin as writing a page: the header Editing, the pin's name with Saved, its tabs, and Done; no strip and one Back. The faction's page as any Codex page: ‹ PAGES, as its crumb on a laptop says, and no strip.

The captures beside their pattern

5

Phone controls the touch stylesheet missed

A, B, C2, C3, C5, D, F, G, I (phones)

On a phone a control's face is its 44 px hit area (T 2.5), and the shared p4t-touch.css grows the kit's buttons, chips, segments and icons. Parts drawn with their own classes stay short: A's search Cancel (13 px), arrival's Dusk and Dawn (32 px), C2's Others can move this (28 px), the composer's dice (34 px), the dice options' stepper (34 px), Level up's choice (36 px), the Codex writer's toolbar (32 px), the Compendium's audience and Climb, fly or swim (30 px) and a filter chip's × (12 px), and the steppers in the Compendium's editor and Settings (42 px).

Fix: Add those classes to p4t-touch.css, so each is 44 px tall on a phone; a chip's × takes the chip's height.

6

Laptop Base line buttons off 36 px

C, C2, C3, C4 and C6; E3, replays; F, finding and pages; F, time and tools; G; I

A Base line button has a 36 px face on a laptop (T 2.5), and the third sweep brought the table's chips and the panels' buttons to it. Still off: Mark used under every turn (32 px), the waiting list's Own tab (30 px), a replay's token chips (32 px) and a player replay's Watch (39 px), the pages index's tag chips (28 px), a record's linked chips in time and tools (32 px), the Compendium's audience (30 px), the New homebrew the third sweep put in its empty spell lists (30 px, from an inline height), and the credentials' Rotate, Revoke and History (32 px), set with no gap, so their lines run together.

Fix: 36 px, with 6 px between neighbours so each keeps its own line; the empty state's New homebrew loses its inline height.

The Codex's next session card carries the horizon

F, the Codex (Home; F's Sessions asks for it)

The horizon is the top of the app and of what opens above it, the chosen tab's ink and the primary's lines (rule 9), and the Cup alone holds one (T 2.4). The Codex home's Next · Session 3 card draws a 2 px horizon with its glow along its top, over the Cup inside it, as F's Sessions asks of the next session's card. No other card carries one.

Fix: The card keeps its cyan tint and loses the edge; its Cup carries the horizon. F's Sessions and its values lose "with the horizon edge".

Small capitals in eight styles

B; C, C2, C3, C4 and C6 (the option table); C5; D; E3, replays; F, the Codex; G

The eyebrow is Bai Jamjuree 600, 11 px capitals at 0.12em in --text-muted (T 2.4), and 287 eyebrows draw it. Others draw their own: the option table's heads (Option, Range, Hit/DC, Damage) at 10 px; a spell card's facts at 10 px and 0.1em; the map tools' options and the builder's class facts at 10.5 px and 0.1em; arrival's Claimed, a death save's Saves and Fails and the log's round lines at 10.5 px; replay columns and a Codex page's facts at 0.1em; the Compendium's CR and Type at 0.08em; arrival's AC, HP and Speed at 9.5 px bold, and its Players join at at 11.5 px bold.

Fix: One eyebrow: 11 px, 0.12em, 600, --text-muted, colour only where it carries a meaning (amber waiting, red dying, violet hidden, the stat block's magenta). Crumbs keep their 12 px label type.

The captures beside their pattern

13

Notices drawn six ways

A; C5; F, finding and pages; F3; G and its pages

A line that tells the reader about the page they are on is drawn as a full-width band with a dark fill (A's Reconnecting), a cyan-tinted band (reading an old version), a 1 px amber box with an amber fill (a downtime that waits), a band with an amber edge (the Compendium's Needs you), a dashed violet box (the note that players never get a stat block, which is not hidden content), and amber words alone (Advantage is armed).

Fix: One notice, as Needs you draws it: a 1 px frame with a 3 px edge at its left in its meaning's colour (amber waiting, cyan reading an old version, violet GM only), no fill, its words in --text. The stat block note loses the dashed box, which marks hidden content (rule 7).
